tagline.en: DIAMOND — a diffusion world model that learns to simulate environments like Atari games and CS:GO, playable directly from its predictions.
tagline.zh: DIAMOND——用扩散模型学习模拟环境的世界模型,可模拟 Atari 游戏与 CS:GO 等场景,并可直接在其预测中游玩。

en: DIAMOND is a diffusion-based world model for reinforcement-learning and game environments. Instead of rendering with a game engine, it learns a diffusion model of an environment's dynamics and generates the next frames from the agent's actions — you can literally play inside the learned model.

It's a lightweight game/RL world-model candidate. The published checkpoints cover environments such as Atari and CS:GO, and a run can use either a local checkpoint or a pretrained game selected non-interactively.

In WorldFoundry the official play/inference stack is run in-tree through the same play entrypoint the upstream repo uses. You point it at staged assets and a checkpoint, and it drives the interactive world model.
zh: DIAMOND 是面向强化学习与游戏环境的扩散式世界模型。它不依赖游戏引擎渲染,而是学习环境动态的扩散模型,并根据智能体的动作生成后续帧——你可以真正在学到的模型里游玩。
它是一个轻量的游戏/强化学习世界模型选项。已发布的 checkpoint 覆盖 Atari 与 CS:GO 等环境,运行时可使用本地 checkpoint,或非交互式地指定一个预训练游戏。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方的游玩/推理栈在仓库内运行,复用了上游仓库使用的同一 play 入口。你把它指向已准备好的资源与 checkpoint,它便驱动这个交互式世界模型。

whenToUse.en: When you want a diffusion world model that simulates game or RL environments and lets you interact with the learned dynamics — for example playing Atari or CS:GO inside the model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个模拟游戏或强化学习环境的扩散世界模型,并能与学到的动态交互时——例如在模型内游玩 Atari 或 CS:GO。

notFor.en: Running the full experience needs staged game assets and checkpoints; runtime network downloads are disabled, so prepare those locally first.
notFor.zh: 完整体验需要预先准备好游戏资源与 checkpoint;运行期的网络下载被禁用,请先在本地备好这些文件。

en: Diffusion world model for RL and game environments
Checkpoints for environments like Atari and CS:GO
Runs from a local checkpoint or a selected pretrained game
zh: 面向强化学习与游戏环境的扩散世界模型
可在学到的动态中直接游玩
提供 Atari、CS:GO 等环境的 checkpoint
可用本地 checkpoint 或指定的预训练游戏运行
